items.name: Intraday-momentum-strategy
items.description: Implementation and analysis of the study "Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY)". This repository replicates the intraday momentum strategy described in the paper, compares data quality from Polygon and Alpaca, and evaluates strategy performance through historical backtesting on SPY.

items.name: zarattini-2024-momentum-spy
items.description: 📈 Independent replication and out-of-sample validation of Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024) "Beat the Market" intraday momentum on SPY and ES futures, with ex-ante frozen anti-overfitting protocols.

items.name: intraday-momentum
items.description: Reproducible implementation and extension of an intraday momentum strategy on SPY + QuantConnect-ready research framework.

items.name: spy-intraday-momentum-oos
items.description: Independent out-of-sample replication of Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2025) intraday momentum strategy for SPY.

items.name: SPY-Intraday-Momentum
items.description: Intraday momentum strategy for SPY - academic backing (Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon 2024). 19.6% annualized return, Sharpe 1.33 over 2007-2024.

items.name: Intraday-Momentum-Strategy-SPY-ETF-Python-
items.description: Event-driven intraday momentum backtester for SPY (1-min data) with time-of-day noise bands, VWAP trailing stops, and vol-targeted sizing. Models costs, logs trades/equity, and reports Sharpe, max DD, alpha/beta, and monthly returns; includes CLI runner and param sweep

items.name: intraday-momentum-replication
items.description: Independent replication and cost analysis of blackswan-quants/intraday-momentum: 58 backtests on SPY, a closed-form cost model, a Deflated Sharpe Ratio

items.name: intraday-momentum-research
items.description: Python SPY/QQQ intraday momentum research: lagged volatility bands, VWAP exits, transaction-cost accounting, capacity diagnostics, and an offline synthetic-data demo.

items.name: spy-mometum-strategy
items.description: Replication and backtest of the SPY intraday momentum strategy from Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2025) on real 30-minute SPY data
